mapper.update: update official_event_binding set status='ACTIVE',update_time=now() where event_id=#{eventId} and status='DRAFT'
update official_event_mission set status='ACTIVE',update_time=now() where event_id=#{eventId} and status='DRAFT'
update official_event_fulfillment_requirement set status='ACTIVE',update_time=now() where event_id=#{eventId} and status='DRAFT'
mapper.select: select from official_event_binding where event_id = #{eventId} order by sort,id
select from official_event_binding where id = #{id}
select from official_event_binding where event_id = #{eventId} and binding_code = #{bindingCode}
select from official_event_mission where event_id = #{eventId} order by sort,id
select from official_event_mission where event_id = #{eventId} and mission_code = #{missionCode}

select m.* from official_event_mission m join official_event_binding b on b.id=m.binding_id join official_event e on e.id=m.event_id where m.mission_type='THEME_VERIFIED_FINISH' and m.status='ACTIVE' and b.binding_type='THEME' and b.source_mode='REFERENCE' and b.source_ref_id=#{topicId} and b.status='ACTIVE' and e.contract_version >= 2 and e.status=3 and coalesce(e.control_state,'NORMAL')='NORMAL'
mapper.delete: delete from official_event_party where event_id = #{eventId} and status='INVITED'
mapper.select: select from official_event_party where event_id=#{eventId} order by role,id
select from official_event_party where id=#{id}
mapper.update: update official_event_party set status=#{status}, status_by=#{operatorId}, status_at=now(), status_reason=#{reason}, update_time=now() where id=#{id}
mapper.select: select from official_event_party where event_id=#{eventId} order by role,id for update

select p.id partyId,p.event_id eventId,p.party_type partyType,p.party_id partyIdValue,p.identity_source identitySource,p.organizer_authority organizerAuthority,p.role,p.target_type targetType,p.target_id targetId, p.window_start windowStart,p.window_end windowEnd,p.capacity,p.responsibility_summary responsibilitySummary,p.status,p.status_reason statusReason, e.title eventTitle,e.city,e.status eventStatus,e.control_state controlState from official_event_party p join official_event e on e.id=p.event_id left join mms_merchant m on p.party_type='MERCHANT' and m.id=p.party_id and m.del_flag=0 left join club c on p.party_type='CLUB' and c.id=p.party_id and c.del_flag=0 where p.status in ('INVITED','ACCEPTED','ACTIVE') and e.contract_version >= 2 and ((p.party_type='OFFICIAL' and p.identity_source='UMS_MEMBER' and p.party_id=#{memberId}) or (p.party_type='MERCHANT' and m.member_id=#{memberId}) or (p.party_type='CLUB' and c.member_id=#{memberId})) order by case p.status when 'INVITED' then 0 else 1 end,p.update_time desc,p.id desc
mapper.update: update official_event_party set status='ACTIVE', status_at=now(), update_time=now() where event_id=#{eventId} and status='ACCEPTED'
update official_event_party set status='COMPLETED', status_at=now(), update_time=now() where event_id=#{eventId} and status in ('ACCEPTED','ACTIVE')
mapper.select: select from official_event_fulfillment_requirement where event_id=#{eventId} order by id
select from official_event_participation where event_id=#{eventId} and member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.update: update official_event_participation set state=#{state},reason=#{reason},invalidated_at=if(#{state}='ACTIVE',null,now()),update_time=now() where event_id=#{eventId} and member_id=#{memberId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from official_event_participation where event_id=#{eventId} and state='ACTIVE'
select member_id from official_event_participation where event_id=#{eventId} and state='ACTIVE' order by member_id
select from official_event_mission_evidence where dedupe_key=#{dedupeKey}
select from official_event_mission_evidence where id=#{id}
select from official_event_mission_evidence where event_id=#{eventId} and member_id=#{memberId} order by occurred_at,id
select count(1) from official_event_mission_evidence where event_id=#{eventId} and mission_id=#{missionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and status='VALID'
select count(1) from official_event_mission_evidence where event_id=#{eventId} and status='VALID'
mapper.update: update official_event_mission_evidence set status='REVOKED',reason=#{reason},operated_by=#{operatorId},revoked_at=now(),update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='VALID'

update official_event_mission_evidence set status='REVOKED',reason=#{reason},operated_by=#{operatorId},revoked_at=now(),update_time=now() where mission_id=#{missionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and status='VALID'

update official_event_mission_evidence set status='REVOKED',reason=#{reason},operated_by=#{operatorId},revoked_at=now(),update_time=now() where source_type=#{sourceType} and source_fact_id=#{sourceFactId} and status='VALID'
mapper.select: select distinct event_id from official_event_mission_evidence where source_type='THEME_EXPLORE' and source_fact_id like concat('registration:',#{registrationId},':topic:',#{topicId},':redemption:%') and status='VALID' order by event_id

select distinct event_id from official_event_mission_evidence where source_type='THEME_EXPLORE' and source_fact_id like concat('registration:',#{registrationId},':topic:',#{topicId},':redemption:%') and status='VALID' order by event_id for update
mapper.update: update official_event_mission_evidence set status='REVOKED',reason=#{reason},operated_by=#{operatorId},revoked_at=now(),update_time=now() where source_type='THEME_EXPLORE' and source_fact_id like concat('registration:',#{registrationId},':topic:',#{topicId},':redemption:%') and status='VALID'
mapper.select: select id,event_id,member_id,reward_rule_version,status,issuance_key,payload_json,failure_reason,source_snapshot_json,create_time,update_time from official_event_reward_issuance where event_id=#{eventId} and member_id=#{memberId} and reward_rule_version=#{rewardRuleVersion}
mapper.update: update official_event_reward_issuance set status='ISSUED',failure_reason=null,update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='PENDING_ISSUE'
update official_event_reward_issuance set status=#{status},failure_reason=#{failureReason},update_time=now() where id=#{id}

update official_event_reward_issuance ri join official_event_mission_evidence e on e.event_id=ri.event_id and e.member_id=ri.member_id set ri.status='MANUAL_REVIEW',ri.failure_reason=#{reason},ri.update_time=now() where e.source_type=#{sourceType} and e.source_fact_id=#{sourceFactId} and ri.status in ('PENDING_ISSUE','ISSUED','CLAIMED')

update official_event_reward_issuance ri join official_event_mission_evidence e on e.event_id=ri.event_id and e.member_id=ri.member_id set ri.status='MANUAL_REVIEW',ri.failure_reason=#{reason},ri.update_time=now() where e.source_type='THEME_EXPLORE' and e.source_fact_id like concat('registration:',#{registrationId},':topic:',#{topicId},':redemption:%') and ri.status in ('PENDING_ISSUE','ISSUED','CLAIMED')

update official_event_reward_issuance ri join official_event_mission_evidence e on e.event_id=ri.event_id and e.member_id=ri.member_id set ri.status='MANUAL_REVIEW',ri.failure_reason=#{reason},ri.update_time=now() where e.id=#{evidenceId} and ri.status in ('PENDING_ISSUE','ISSUED','CLAIMED')

update official_event_reward_issuance set status='MANUAL_REVIEW',failure_reason=#{reason},update_time=now() where event_id=#{eventId} and member_id=#{memberId} and status in ('PENDING_ISSUE','ISSUED','CLAIMED')
mapper.select: select from event_arrival_verification where event_id=#{eventId} and mission_id=#{missionId} and member_id=#{memberId} and request_id=#{requestId}

select v.occurred_at as foundAt, coalesce(p.lat, b.latitude) as lat, coalesce(p.lng, b.longitude) as lng from event_arrival_verification v join official_event_binding b on b.id = v.binding_id left join roam_poi p on b.binding_type = 'ROAM_POI' and p.id = b.source_ref_id where v.member_id = #{memberId} and v.result = 'ACCEPTED' order by v.occurred_at desc, v.id desc limit 1

select m.id missionId,m.mission_code missionCode,m.title,m.mission_type missionType,m.status,b.binding_type bindingType,b.binding_code bindingCode, count(distinct case when e.status='VALID' then e.member_id end) validMembers, count(case when e.status='VALID' then 1 end) validEvidence, count(case when e.status='REVOKED' then 1 end) revokedEvidence from official_event_mission m join official_event_binding b on b.id=m.binding_id left join official_event_mission_evidence e on e.mission_id=m.id where m.event_id=#{eventId} group by m.id,m.mission_code,m.title,m.mission_type,m.status,b.binding_type,b.binding_code order by m.sort,m.id

select r.id requirementId,r.mission_id missionId,r.target_type targetType,r.target_id targetId,r.window_start windowStart,r.window_end windowEnd,r.required_role requiredRole,r.required_capacity requiredCapacity,r.critical, count(p.id) coveredBy from official_event_fulfillment_requirement r left join official_event_party p on p.event_id=r.event_id and p.status in ('ACCEPTED','ACTIVE') and p.role=r.required_role and p.target_type=r.target_type and p.target_id=r.target_id and ((r.required_role='FULFILLMENT_MERCHANT' and p.party_type='MERCHANT') or (r.required_role='FULFILLMENT_CLUB' and p.party_type='CLUB')) and coalesce(p.capacity,0) >= coalesce(r.required_capacity,0) and r.window_start is not null and r.window_end is not null and p.window_start is not null and p.window_end is not null and p.window_start <= r.window_start and p.window_end >= r.window_end where r.event_id=#{eventId} and r.status='ACTIVE' group by r.id,r.mission_id,r.target_type,r.target_id,r.window_start,r.window_end,r.required_role,r.required_capacity,r.critical order by r.id

select p.member_id memberId,p.state,count(distinct case when e.status='VALID' then e.mission_id end) completedMissions, ri.status rewardStatus,ri.failure_reason failureReason from official_event_participation p left join official_event_mission_evidence e on e.event_id=p.event_id and e.member_id=p.member_id left join official_event_reward_issuance ri on ri.event_id=p.event_id and ri.member_id=p.member_id where p.event_id=#{eventId} group by p.member_id,p.state,ri.status,ri.failure_reason order by p.member_id

select distinct e.id,e.title,e.subtitle,e.city,e.status,e.activity_start activityStart,e.activity_end activityEnd, case when p.id is null then false else true end signed from official_event e join official_event_mission m on m.event_id=e.id and m.status='ACTIVE' and m.mission_type in ('ROAM_POI_ARRIVAL','EVENT_POINT_ARRIVAL') join official_event_binding b on b.id=m.binding_id and b.status='ACTIVE' left join official_event_participation p on p.event_id=e.id and p.member_id=#{memberId} and p.state='ACTIVE' where e.contract_version >= 2 and e.status in (2,3) and coalesce(e.control_state,'NORMAL')='NORMAL' and (#{city} is null or #{city}='' or e.city is null or e.city like concat('%',#{city},'%')) order by e.sort desc,e.id desc

select e.id,e.title,e.subtitle,e.category,e.cover_img coverImg,e.city,e.status,e.contract_version contractVersion, e.fulfillment_policy fulfillmentPolicy,e.control_state controlState,e.banner_enabled bannerEnabled,e.signup_start signupStart,e.activity_start activityStart, e.activity_end activityEnd,e.settle_time settleTime, (select count(1) from official_event_participation p where p.event_id=e.id and p.state='ACTIVE') participants, exists(select 1 from official_event_participation p where p.event_id=e.id and p.member_id=#{memberId} and p.state='ACTIVE') signed from official_event e where e.contract_version >= 2 and e.status >= 1 and e.status <> 9 and (#{city} is null or #{city}='' or e.city is null or e.city like concat('%',#{city},'%')) order by e.sort desc,e.id desc

select e.id,e.title,e.subtitle,e.category,e.cover_img coverImg,e.city,e.status,e.contract_version contractVersion, e.control_state controlState,e.banner_enabled bannerEnabled,e.signup_start signupStart,e.activity_start activityStart, e.activity_end activityEnd,e.settle_time settleTime,p.state participationState,p.joined_at joinedAt from official_event_participation p join official_event e on e.id=p.event_id where p.member_id=#{memberId} and e.contract_version >= 2 order by e.activity_end desc,e.id desc
select from official_event_operator_authorization where active_sys_user_id=#{sysUserId} and status='ACTIVE' limit 1
select from official_event_operator_authorization where active_sys_user_id=#{sysUserId} and status='ACTIVE' limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update official_event_operator_authorization set active_sys_user_id=null,status='REVOKED',revoked_by=#{revokedBy},revoked_at=now(),revoke_reason=#{revokeReason},update_time=now() where id=#{id} and status='ACTIVE'

update official_event set control_state=#{controlState},paused_from_status=#{pausedFromStatus},paused_at=#{pausedAt}, paused_by=#{pausedBy},paused_reason=#{pausedReason},pause_impact_scope=#{pauseImpactScope}, pause_alternative_plan=#{pauseAlternativePlan},pause_notification_plan=#{pauseNotificationPlan}, pause_notification_status=#{pauseNotificationStatus},resume_note=#{resumeNote},update_time=now() where id=#{eventId}
